import os
import sqlite3
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))

from src.repository import initialize
from src.service import get_document, list_documents

VISIBLE_KEYS = {"id", "title", "body"}
INSERT = "INSERT INTO documents (id, tenant, owner, title, body, deleted_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)"


class RecordingConnection:
    """Delegates execute() to a real connection and records each SQL text with its parameters."""

    def __init__(self, connection):
        self.connection = connection
        self.calls = []

    def execute(self, sql, parameters=()):
        self.calls.append((sql, tuple(parameters)))
        return self.connection.execute(sql, parameters)


class ScopedAccessTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.c = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
        initialize(self.c)
        seed = [
            # id, tenant, owner, title, body, deleted_at
            (5, "t1", "alice", "A3", "a3 body", None),          # visible to (t1, alice)
            (3, "t1", "bob", "B1", "b1 body", None),            # same tenant, other owner
            (1, "t1", "alice", "A1", "a1 body", None),          # visible to (t1, alice)
            (4, "t2", "alice", "X1", "x1 body", None),          # same owner, other tenant
            (2, "t1", "alice", "A2", "a2 body", "2026-01-01"),  # deleted
        ]
        self.c.executemany(INSERT, seed)
        self.c.commit()

    def add(self, row):
        self.c.execute(INSERT, row)
        self.c.commit()

    def test_get_returns_id_title_body_for_visible_document(self):
        self.assertEqual(get_document(self.c, "t1", "alice", 1), {"id": 1, "title": "A1", "body": "a1 body"})

    def test_get_returns_none_for_cross_owner_cross_tenant_deleted_and_missing(self):
        for document_id in (3, 4, 2, 999):
            with self.subTest(document_id=document_id):
                self.assertIsNone(get_document(self.c, "t1", "alice", document_id))

    def test_list_returns_only_visible_documents_ordered_by_id(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            list_documents(self.c, "t1", "alice"),
            [{"id": 1, "title": "A1", "body": "a1 body"}, {"id": 5, "title": "A3", "body": "a3 body"}],
        )

    def test_list_items_carry_no_deletion_metadata(self):
        for item in list_documents(self.c, "t1", "alice"):
            self.assertEqual(set(item), VISIBLE_KEYS)

    def test_list_is_empty_for_unknown_tenant_or_owner(self):
        self.assertEqual(list_documents(self.c, "t9", "alice"), [])
        self.assertEqual(list_documents(self.c, "t1", "nobody"), [])

    def test_names_containing_quotes_match_exactly(self):
        self.add((6, "o'brien", 'say "hi"', "Q", "q body", None))
        self.assertEqual(get_document(self.c, "o'brien", 'say "hi"', 6), {"id": 6, "title": "Q", "body": "q body"})
        self.assertEqual(list_documents(self.c, "o'brien", 'say "hi"'), [{"id": 6, "title": "Q", "body": "q body"}])
        self.assertIsNone(get_document(self.c, "o'brien", "alice", 6))
        self.assertEqual(list_documents(self.c, "o'brien", "alice"), [])

    def test_injection_style_names_do_not_widen_access(self):
        payload = "x' OR '1'='1"
        self.assertEqual(list_documents(self.c, payload, "alice"), [])
        self.assertEqual(list_documents(self.c, "t1", payload), [])
        self.assertIsNone(get_document(self.c, payload, "alice", 1))
        self.assertIsNone(get_document(self.c, "t1", payload, 1))

    def test_none_names_fail_closed(self):
        self.add((7, None, None, "N", "n body", None))
        self.assertEqual(list_documents(self.c, None, None), [])
        self.assertIsNone(get_document(self.c, None, None, 7))

    def test_names_are_passed_as_bound_parameters(self):
        tenant, owner = "o'brien", 'x" OR 1=1 --'
        recorder = RecordingConnection(self.c)
        get_document(recorder, tenant, owner, 1)
        list_documents(recorder, tenant, owner)
        self.assertEqual(len(recorder.calls), 2)
        for sql, parameters in recorder.calls:
            self.assertNotIn(tenant, sql)
            self.assertNotIn(owner, sql)
            self.assertIn(tenant, parameters)
            self.assertIn(owner, parameters)
            self.assertEqual(sql.count("?"), len(parameters))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
EOF
